questions.question: How is direct binary FSK modulation generated?

choices.A: By keying an FM transmitter with a sub-audible tone
choices.B: By changing an oscillator’s frequency directly with a digital control signal
choices.C: By using a transceiver’s computer data interface protocol to change frequencies
choices.D: By reconfiguring the CW keying input to act as a tone generator

questions.answer: By changing an oscillator’s frequency directly with a digital control signal

questions.question: What is the modulation envelope of an AM signal?

choices.A: The waveform created by connecting the peak values of the modulated signal
choices.B: The carrier frequency that contains the signal
choices.C: Spurious signals that envelop nearby frequencies
choices.D: The bandwidth of the modulated signal

questions.answer: The waveform created by connecting the peak values of the modulated signal

questions.question: What is QPSK modulation?

choices.A: Modulation using quasi-parallel to serial conversion to reduce bandwidth
choices.B: Modulation using quadra-pole sideband keying to generate spread spectrum signals
choices.C: Modulation using Fast Fourier Transforms to generate frequencies at the first, second, third, and fourth harmonics of the carrier frequency to improve noise immunity
choices.D: Modulation in which digital data is transmitted using 0-, 90-, 180- and 270-degrees phase shift to represent pairs of bits

questions.answer: Modulation in which digital data is transmitted using 0-, 90-, 180- and 270-degrees phase shift to represent pairs of bits

questions.question: What is a link budget?

choices.A: The financial costs associated with operating a radio link
choices.B: The sum of antenna gains minus system losses
choices.C: The sum of transmit power and antenna gains minus system losses as seen at the receiver
choices.D: The difference between transmit power and receiver sensitivity

questions.answer: The sum of transmit power and antenna gains minus system losses as seen at the receiver

questions.question: What is link margin?

choices.B: The difference between received power level and minimum required signal level at the input to the receiver

questions.answer: The difference between received power level and minimum required signal level at the input to the receiver
